    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AcquisitionHook
    Building effect that fires every time the player adds a character to their tribe.
    ActionValidator
    Validates PlayerActions before Game applies them to the model.
    AnsiStyle
    ANSI escape sequences and emoji used by TuiView.
    Artist
    Artist character card.
    Board
    Ground truth of the current game state.
    Board.ResolvedEvent
    Result of resolving one event, including per-player resource changes.
    BoardSnapshot
    Immutable snapshot of the visible board state at a given moment.
    Builder
    During the game: reduces the food cost of every building acquired.
    Building
    Food cost= base cost - total builder discount accumulated in the player's tribe
    BuildingEffect
    Describes the effects of a building card.
    BuildingEffect.Builder
     
    BuildingEffectRegistry
    Centralised registry of all building effects.
    Card
    Abstract base class for all game cards (character, building, event).
    CardCellFactory
    Factory for reusable JavaFX nodes: cards, offer tiles, the turn order tile, the tribe deck, and the player/tribe summary.
    CardImageCache
    Cached loader for card images.
    CardLoader
    Loads all game cards from a JSON file.
    CardLocalization
    Localized Italian descriptions for building effects, keyed by card ID.
    CardSnapshot
    Immutable snapshot of a card, carried by GameEvents and sent over the network.
    CardSnapshot.CharacterDetails
    Distinguishing data for character cards.
    CardSnapshot.Type
     
    CavePaintings
    Strategy for the Cave Paintings event.
    Character
    Base class for character cards.
    CharacterType
     
    ClientApp
    Client entry point.
    ClientConnection
    Abstraction over a connected client, regardless of transport (Socket or RMI).
    ClientController
    Client-side controller.
    DatabaseConfig
    Loads and exposes the MySQL configuration for the Mesos leaderboard.
    DatabaseInitializer
    Bootstrap component for the leaderboard storage.
    EndGameScorer
    Building effect that contributes to the player's final score.
    Era
     
    Event
    Event card There are 4 event types (Sustenance, Hunt, Shamanic Ritual, Cave Paintings), Event cards can never be taken by players Resolution logic is delegated to an EventStrategy.
    EventHook
    Building effect that fires during the resolution of a specific event.
    EventStrategy
    Strategy pattern Each event type implements this interface with its own calculation logic over all players.
    EventType
     
    FinalEvent
    Final event card.
    FinalScoreBreakdown
    Immutable explanation of one player's final score calculation.
    FxUtils
    Shared utilities for JavaFX controllers.
    Game
    Pure game model (Model role in MVC).
    GameBoardView
    JavaFX view controller for the main game scene (game.fxml).
    GameBuilder
    Builds and configures a complete game (Builder pattern).
    GameController
    Game controller (Controller role in MVC).
    GameEvent
    Domain events published by Game to its registered listeners.
    GameEvent.CardAcquired
    A player has acquired a card.
    GameEvent.CardAcquisitionFailed
    A player attempted to take a building but had insufficient food.
    GameEvent.CardSlotReady
    The model is waiting for a TakeCardAction or a PassAction.
    GameEvent.EraChanged
    A new era has begun.
    GameEvent.EventResolved
    An event card has been resolved.
    GameEvent.GameEnded
    The game is over.
    GameEvent.PostRoundStarted
    Post-round phase: all totems are on the Turn Order Tile.
    GameEvent.RoundEnded
    The round has ended (after events, discard, and row refill).
    GameEvent.RoundStarted
    A new round has started.
    GameEvent.TotemPlaced
    A player has placed their totem on an offer tile.
    GameEvent.TotemReturnedToTurnOrder
    A player finished their tile action and placed their totem on the Turn Order Tile.
    GameEventListener
    Lets something listen to what happens in the game (Observer pattern).
    GameOverController
    Controller for the game-over screen.
    GameOverController.LbRow
    Row for the lower historical leaderboard table.
    GameOverController.Row
    Row for the current game's final ranking table.
    GameServer
    GameServer encapsulates the complete server startup: - Loads cards from JSON - Bootstraps the leaderboard database - Starts the LobbyServer (Socket TCP) - Starts the RMI registry alongside
    GameSession
    One active game session on the server.
    GameView
    View interface (View role in MVC).
    Gatherer
    Sustenance event: each gatherer provides a discount of 3 food on the total amount to pay.
    Hunt
    Strategy for the Hunt event.
    Hunter
    Immediate effect: if this hunter carries the trigger icon, the player immediately takes 1 food for every hunter currently in their tribe
    InterruptibleInput
    Stdin reader that can be interrupted through Thread.interrupt().
    Inventor
    Each inventor shows exactly one invention icon End of game: (inventor count) × (distinct invention icon count)
    JavaFxApp
    JavaFX entry point for the client application.
    JavaFxView
    JavaFX implementation of GameView.
    LeaderboardEntry
    Immutable row of the leaderboard.
    LeaderboardRepository
    Data Access Object for the leaderboard.
    LobbyController
    Controller for the lobby/login screen.
    LobbyController.ConnectionParams
    Parameters collected from the form and passed to JavaFxView for the actual connection.
    LobbyServer
    TCP lobby server.
    Message
    Network message: a type string + a JSON payload.
    Message.SessionInfo
    Lightweight description of an open session, included in SESSION_LIST.
    OfferTile
    A single tile on the Offer Track.
    OfferTiles
    The Offer Track: the ordered sequence of active offer tiles for a given game.
    OfferTileSnapshot
    Immutable snapshot of an offer tile.
    PassAction
    The player skips the current card slot instead of acquiring a card.
    PlaceTotemAction
    The player places their totem on an offer tile.
    Player
    Represents a player in the game.
    PlayerAction
    An action that a player can perform during their turn (Command pattern).

    PlayerSnapshot
    Immutable snapshot of a player's visible state at a specific moment.
    PostRoundAction
    the player uses the Watchtower building to take one extra card from the top row after all totems have been repositioned.

    Strategy for the Shamanic Ritual event.

    SocketServerProxy

    Stub implementation of GameView for development and testing.
